dataset_name: Alibaton Performance & Development - Canonical LMS Defense Dataset
authority: This file is the source of truth for LMS defense/demo course catalog and learner-history seeding until explicitly replaced by a newer version.

dataset_scope.statement: All learning histories below are controlled defense/demo data aligned to the canonical personnel structure; they are not asserted as production HR records supplied by the client.

non_negotiable_rules: Only canonical personnel with a personnel_key may receive LMS learner assignments.
Generic admin/hr/user demo accounts must never be learners, course owners, reviewers, publishers, or analytics subjects.
Every active canonical person has an LMS history or an active learning assignment.
Pre-Test is diagnostic and must be recorded before course content begins; it never blocks access and has no passing requirement.
Post-Test is the required completion assessment. Passing score is 80% unless a future approved course version explicitly states otherwise.
A learner may retry a Post-Test up to 3 attempts. A failed first attempt remains In Progress / Post-Test Retake, not Completed.
Completion requires all required lessons, required knowledge checks, and a passed Post-Test.
Certificates are internal Alibaton LMS Certificates of Completion only and are issued only for courses whose completion rules explicitly enable certificates.
Completed records are immutable historical outcomes; later renewals create new assignments/version lineage rather than rewriting prior completion.
Course assignment and progress data must never be inferred from array order or database ID order; every learner-course relationship is explicitly declared in this file.

implementation_gap_to_fix.current_system: The uploaded build currently exposes only Knowledge Check and Final Assessment assessment types in the frontend/domain, and completion logic specifically recognizes Final Assessment.
target_required_by_this_dataset: Add first-class Post-Test assessment type (or migrate current Final Assessment semantics to Post-Test).
Pre-Test must be diagnostic and excluded from pass-gated completion.
Post-Test must be course-level, required for completion, and support up to 3 attempts.
Learner UI, Admin Learning UI, analytics, attempts, transcripts, and reports must visibly distinguish Pre-Test from Post-Test.
